enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will preferentially add samples where the current winner demonstrably errs, giving the highest chance to shave the remaining RMSE gap within the last two iterations.

diagnosis: The bottleneck is data coverage in specific input directions (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) producing structured residuals, while train/val split noise is low and the learning curve has not plateaued.
